sources.temp_range: Difference between mean daytime and mean nighttime THEMIS observations (same definition as lst_mean_diff). Provisional.
sources.temp_min: Mean of 5 THEMIS nighttime Avg Surface Temp observations (I02413002, I13035002, I26775011, I48277005, I75405013), K converted to degC. Provisional: small sample of single-time observations, not a full diurnal mean. Provided by member C.
sources.albedo: THEMIS observation I75667014, TES Albedo Avg. Single-observation provisional value, not a regional average; definition may differ from MODIS broadband albedo.
sources.slope: MGS MOLA MEGDR megt44n000hb.img; 28x28 km footprint centred at 18.4N, 77.5E; resampled to ~500 m; Horn 3x3 slope. Provided by member C.
sources.roughness: MGS MOLA MEGDR megt44n000hb.img; 28x28 km footprint centred at 18.4N, 77.5E; resampled to ~500 m; Horn 3x3 slope. Provided by member C. Std = standard deviation of slope values; ddof (0 or 1) not yet confirmed.
sources.mafic: Jezero crater-floor geology; Science Advances study, DOI 10.1126/sciadv.abo3399 (member C to verify the citation). Qualitative, not comparable with the numeric ASTER index. (categorical 'high' -> 85th percentile of Earth mafic_idx)
sources.aridity: Project assumption for present-day Mars: effectively no liquid precipitation.

sources.temp_range: LRO Diviner Polar Cumulative Products (diurnal, south pole), bolometric temperature, 240 m bins, 28x28 km box centred on pole, summer+winter pooled, nadir obs. 5 Jul 2009 - 17 Feb 2019, every 8th 0.25 h local-time bin; computed with diviner_temps.py + finalize_temps.py; mean(day) - mean(night) over the box (small because the Sun stays near the horizon); max-min spread is 253.5 C
sources.temp_min: LRO Diviner Polar Cumulative Products (diurnal, south pole), bolometric temperature, 240 m bins, 28x28 km box centred on pole, summer+winter pooled, nadir obs. 5 Jul 2009 - 17 Feb 2019, every 8th 0.25 h local-time bin; computed with diviner_temps.py + finalize_temps.py; mean over all bins in the box, then mean over the local-time bins; summer+winter pooled (seasonal means are in the finalize_temps.py printout); day = local time 06-18 h, night = 18-06 h, NOT the same as sunlit/unlit near the pole
sources.slope: LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, Planet. Sci. J. 4, 183, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1; DOI 10.60903/gsfcpgda-lola-spole); 28x28 km centred on pole; resampled to 500 m (average); Horn 3x3 slope; 3136 px; computed with lola_slope.py
sources.roughness: Same as slope_mean; population std (ddof=0) - to match Jezero setting
sources.mafic: Lunar south polar highlands are anorthositic with low FeO (Lunar Prospector GRS, Lawrence et al. 2002, JGR 107(E12)) (categorical 'low' -> 15th percentile of Earth mafic_idx)
sources.sun_angle: Computed: 90 - |lat| + axial tilt (1.54 deg); verify tilt on NASA Moon Fact Sheet
